title: Deploying your first application, from manifest to browser

videos.script: This is the lesson where the shop goes online, on the cluster, the declarative way. {{online}} One file holds two objects. A Deployment says: keep three copies of this image running. A Service says: give them one address. {{file}} You will read that file part by part, apply it, and watch three pods appear on two nodes. {{apply}} Then you will reach the shop twice from the laptop. First through a tunnel that kubectl opens, which is the debugging way. Then through a port on the nodes, the way a browser would arrive. {{reach}} Six requests, three different pods answering. And the logs of all three, in one command. {{logs}}
